label: Lang Co
short_description: A former fishing village and lagoon-and-beach resort strip roughly midway between Hue and Da Nang.
intro: Lang Co's hotel coverage in this directory covers a small stretch of resort-only properties on a narrow spit of land between the East Sea and the Lap An lagoon, roughly midway between Hue and Da Nang and about 75 minutes from either city's airport. There's no real town center to speak of -- the draw is the 3-kilometer beach itself and the mountain scenery of the Hai Van Pass just to the north -- so this is a self-contained resort stay rather than a base for exploring a city, with Hue's imperial sites and Da Nang/Hoi An typically visited as day trips.
